mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_score_main (shop_id, score_period, total_score, shop_level, score_user, score_time, opinion, create_time) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{scorePeriod}, #{totalScore}, #{shopLevel}, #{scoreUser}, #{scoreTime}, #{opinion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW())

INSERT INTO shop_score_item (main_id, shop_id, score_rule, full_score, actual_score, remark, create_time) VALUES
(#{i.mainId}, #{i.shopId}, #{i.scoreRule}, #{i.fullScore}, #{i.actualScore}, #{i.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT i.score_rule, CASE i.score_rule WHEN 1 THEN '商品合规' WHEN 2 THEN '服务' WHEN 3 THEN '履约' WHEN 4 THEN '品质' WHEN 5 THEN '配合' WHEN 6 THEN '违规' ELSE '未知' END AS score_rule_name, i.full_score, i.actual_score, i.remark FROM shop_score_item i WHERE i.main_id = #{mainId} ORDER BY i.score_rule ASC
mapper.sql: m.main_id, m.shop_id, s.shop_name, m.score_period, m.total_score, m.shop_level, m.score_user, m.score_time, m.opinion, m.create_time
